behavior: New Shared Texture media select the first external SDK sender or None. Every visible option keeps its exact SDK key.
Same-process Screen output registrations carry an (internal) label. Deliberate internal selection is available in Auto and Manual Detect.

A source seeded from the catalog can reconnect to the same external name. An internal registration of that name stays unavailable to that source. Manual/Auto changes preserve the authored key and policy.
An explicit sender edit can select an internal endpoint, including an explicit selection of the existing name. Policy and name survive history, copy and reload.

checks: root and Golden Core cargo fmt
bundled app and native observer compilation
software.coverage: Manager, folder, owned Composition, Matrix Cell, script, command and transport creation. Metadata fencing, origin and labels, duplicate/reload and explicit exact selection.

headless.scope: Real SDK zero, one and two senders, explicit None across rediscovery, exact restart, mode history, and Save/New/Load with the None option restored.

native.checkout: Working checkout including the existing unrelated local workspace edits

scope: Process-owned Screen sender provenance. A sender in a separate process is external to the current app. Separate codec/format, alternate-GPU, sustained performance and final release gates retain their existing scope.
